name: standoff
title: SMD spacer, internal thread
summary: Surface-mount spacer with an internal thread: a tin-plated steel tube (length, outer_diameter, bore_diameter, chamfer, bore_chamfer).
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); the profile of Würth Elektronik's public WA-SMSI drawing (SMT Steel Spacer with internal Thread, M3, order code 9774015360R, revision 001.002, 2020-05-11; a copy at https://docs.rs-online.com/6ef4/0900766b8166610d.pdf downloaded 18 November 2026) without the spigot; chamfers and the bore (the M3 thread's minor diameter) estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
